issues.description: The script overrides XMLHttpRequest to capture all XHR requests and allows replaying them using GM_xmlhttpRequest. However, all requests are only sent to the same origin (character.ai) and there is no evidence of exfiltration to third-party servers.
issues.recommendation: Ensure that captured requests are not sent to unintended destinations. Monitor for any future code changes that might introduce third-party endpoints.

issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which is necessary for its replay functionality, but does not request any other high-risk permissions.
issues.recommendation: Limit permissions to only those required. No action needed unless new permissions are added.

summary: The script does not transmit data to third-party servers, does not collect sensitive user data, and does not use dangerous code execution patterns. It only interacts with the character.ai domain and provides a utility to replay recent XHR requests. No critical or high-risk issues were found. The overall risk is LOW.
